Open one palette to
find native slash com"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"mands, recent sessions, visible UI actions, and installed

plugin settings—without leaving the keyboard."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **One shortcut:** `⌘K` on macOS, `Ctrl+K` on other platforms.
- **Customizable:** click the shortc"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ut control in the footer, then press a new
key combination. The setting is stored in the current bro"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"wser.
- **Native actions:** discovers and triggers the actions already provided by
DSH Web, and cont"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ributes one `/spotlight` command to the native slash menu
instead of maintaining a second command re"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"gistry.
- **Fast search:** deterministic fuzzy matching across slash commands, recent
sessions, UI a"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"ctions, and plugin settings.
- **Keyboard navigation:** Arrow Up/Down to select, Enter to run, Escap"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"e to
close.
- **Clean lifecycle:** removes its event listeners, styles, and DOM nodes when
unloaded."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Install the bundle into your DSH Web profile. `lib/` directory with the repository-local TypeScr"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ipt and tsdown executables;
it does not access the network or write outside the checkout. If lifecyc"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"le
scripts are disabled, install the npm release instead: it already contains the
built `lib/` files"},{"id":"p12s5","text":" and does not run `prepare` during installation."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Then start DSH Web and press `⌘K` or `Ctrl+K`:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"1. 2. Type to filter commands and actions.
3. Use Arrow Up/Down and Enter,"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" or click a result.
4. Click **Shortcut** in the footer to record a different key combination.
5. Cl"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"ick **Reset** to restore the platform default."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Shortcut preferences are local to the current browser origin and profile."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"DSH Spotlight is a standalone Cordis bundle with a small Web client. The
client mounts once the host"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"'s sessions, command-plane, plugin-inventory, and
command-UI services exist — all standard in every "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"stock DSH Web deployment —
then reads recent sessions, slash commands, and the plugin inventory dire"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ctly
from those services. It also discovers actionable elements in the current page
and delegates ex"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"ecution back to those native elements. A catalog RPC failure
degrades only its own category. The plu"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"gin adds no server data channel and
